prompt: Can you add one minute to the time of the title track from the album released by Ray Charles in the year before Phil Quartararo took over as president of its record label?
answer:
Ray Charles’s **_My World_** was released in 1993, the year before Phil Quartararo became president of Warner Bros. Records. Its title track, **“My World,”** runs **4:01**.

Adding one minute gives **5:01**.
